evals.prompt: I'm putting together a page for our corporate year-end gala packages at 360 Vision Events. Can you build me a single self-contained HTML file with a hero, three short feature cards (planning, AV, décor) and a closing call-to-action? Keep it on brand.
evals.expected_output: index.html on the dark canvas with brand orange CTAs, Space Grotesk/Inter Tight, surface cards with hairline borders, on-brand copy.
assertions: Page background is the brand canvas #0b0b0c (directly or via a token)
Brand orange #ff4000 is used for the primary call-to-action
Text on orange buttons is dark (#0b0b0c), not white
Headings use Space Grotesk and body text uses Inter Tight
No off-palette colours or light theme are introduced (no extra hues such as blue/green/purple, no white page background)
Feature cards use the surface #1a1a1c with a 1px translucent white border
CTA labels are sentence-case imperatives and the page contains no exclamation marks
No invented metrics, testimonials, guest counts, awards or prices

evals.prompt: Write a short LinkedIn post and a matching client email announcing that 360 Vision Events now offers full AV and LED wall packages for product launches in Gauteng. Keep it in our brand voice.
evals.expected_output: copy.md with a LinkedIn post and an email in the staccato, floor-focused, WhatsApp-first brand voice.
assertions: Uses the brand name '360 Vision Events' exactly
Contains no exclamation marks
Uses UK/SA spelling (no US forms such as color, center, organize, program meaning programme)
Includes a WhatsApp-first or 'Send a brief' style call to action
Uses short staccato statements ending in full stops in headlines/hooks
Uses the brand's core vocabulary (e.g. 'floor', 'brief', 'production path' or the ONE team mantra)
No invented metrics, testimonials, prices or client claims
Does not include personal phone numbers or street addresses (generic info@ or a marked placeholder only)

evals.prompt: We're starting a small internal booking dashboard for 360 Vision Events in Next.js with Tailwind v4 and shadcn/ui. Give me the globals.css theme setup so it matches our brand, plus a primary and an outline button example.
evals.expected_output: globals.css with the site's :root variables and a Tailwind v4 theme mapping, plus a button example.
assertions: --primary is #ff4000 and --primary-foreground is #0b0b0c
--background is #0b0b0c, --foreground #f5f5f4, --card #1a1a1c and --muted-foreground #8a8a8e
--radius is .5rem (0.5rem)
Fonts are Inter Tight for body/sans and Space Grotesk for display/headings
Does not invent a light-mode brand palette (dark-only, or explicitly flags light mode as not part of the brand)
Outline button hover uses the brand orange (accent = #ff4000) rather than a grey/neutral accent

evals.prompt: Draft a quotation for a 300-guest product launch for a client called Northwind Mining, with sound, a stage and an LED wall. Use our quote layout and keep it on brand.
evals.expected_output: An A4 quotation HTML built on the bundled templates/quotation.html structure and document.css, with grouped line items and placeholders for unknown details.
assertions: Starts from the bundled templates/quotation.html (or reproduces its structure and links document.css/tokens.css)
Keeps the quotation sections in order: title block, parties, project details with total, 01 brief and terms, 02 specification, 03 schedule, 04 client acceptance
Line items are grouped with subtotals, and every row total equals quantity x unit rate
Amounts use the South African format 'R 12 345.00'
Uses [placeholders] for unknown banking, registration and contact details rather than inventing them
Dark canvas #0b0b0c by default, brand orange #ff4000, Space Grotesk headings and Inter Tight body
Section headings are sentence case and end with full stops; no exclamation marks
